nameOrigin: a piece of cotton (referring to Swablu's wings)

pokedexEntries.ru: SWABLU has light and fluffy wings that are like cottony clouds. This POKéMON is not frightened of people. It lands on the heads of people and sits there like a cotton-fluff hat.

pokedexEntries.sa: SWABLU loves to make things clean. If it spots something dirty, it will wipe and polish it with its cottony wings. If its wings become dirty, this POKéMON finds a stream and showers itself.

pokedexEntries.frlg: It constantly grooms its cotton-like wings. It takes a shower to clean itself if it becomes dirty.

pokedexEntries.em: A POKéMON that has wings like cottony clouds. After enduring winter, in which little food is available, SWABLU flocks move closer to towns in the spring.

pokedexEntries.dp: Its wings are like cotton tufts. If it perches on someone’s head, it looks like a cotton hat.

pokedexEntries.pt: It can’t relax if it or its surroundings are not clean. It wipes off dirt with its wings.

pokedexEntries.hgss: Its wings bring cottony clouds to mind. It grooms with springwater and loves to sit on heads.

pokedexEntries.bw: It can’t relax if it or its surroundings are not clean. It wipes off dirt with its wings.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: For some reason, it likes to land on people’s heads softly and act like it’s a hat.

pokedexEntries.y: It constantly grooms its cotton-like wings. It takes a shower to clean itself if it becomes dirty.

pokedexEntries.sw: Its cottony wings are full of air, making them light and fluffy to the touch. Swablu takes diligent care of its wings.

pokedexEntries.sh: Since Swablu looks like a cumulus cloud, foes can have a hard time finding it. Apparently its wings turned white over many generations.
